description:
Despite being outshot 34-18 by the Golden Knights in Las Vegas, the Arizona Coyotes managed to secure a narrow 2-0 victory, thanks in large part to goaltender Connor Ingram, who made several crucial saves throughout the game. In the first period, during a Vegas power play, Ingram thwarted Jack Eichel's shot from the point and then denied Mark Stone's subsequent rebound attempt. Midway through the scoreless second period, Ingram made a key stop on Michael Amadio's attempts. Late in the second period, with the game still tied and Vegas on another power play, Ingram skillfully caught Alex Pietrangelo's redirection out of the air with his glove. Arizona eventually found the net in the third period and sealed the win with an empty-net goal, while Ingram impressively stopped all 34 shots he faced.

description:
In his debut season with the Rangers, goaltender Jonathan Quick delivered a stellar performance in Pittsburgh, turning away all 32 shots he faced to secure a 1-0 victory. During the initial period, Quick skillfully blocked a Reilly Smith attempt right at the doorstep. Early in the third period, while maintaining a one-goal lead, Quick executed a remarkable save, swiftly extending his right pad to thwart Sidney Crosby's one-timer attempt. As the clock ticked down with the goalie pulled for an extra attacker and less than 15 seconds left in the game, Crosby found himself alone in the slot, but Quick made another incredible stop, this time using his shoulder to deny the puck. This shutout marked Quick's 60th in his illustrious career, a feat achieved by only 19 other goalies in NHL history.

description:
In a matchup against the undefeated Colorado Avalanche, who had started the season with a 6-0-0 record, Tristan Jarry delivered a stellar performance, securing a home victory for Pittsburgh. During the early stages of the second period, with his team leading 2-0, Jarry displayed his acrobatics by making a big blocker save on Fredrik Olofsson's point-blank shot. Later, as the Avalanche pressed on the power play towards the end of the same period, Jarry showcased his lightning-quick reflexes by snatching Jonathan Drouin's shot out of the air. In the third period, on another Colorado power play, Jarry's glove-hand precision was on full display as he made a beautiful save on Bowen Byram's attempt. Jarry's incredible performance culminated in a shutout, stopping all 31 shots he faced, and earned him the first star of the game honors.

description:
In a face off between the Toronto Maple Leafs and the Ottawa Senators, rookie goaltender Joseph Woll delivered a stellar performance, securing a road victory for his team in the heated "Battle of Ontario" matchup. In the midst of a scoreless first period, Ottawa gained a two-on-one opportunity down low, but Woll showcased his brilliance with an incredible glove save, denying what seemed to be a certain goal by Vladimir Tarasenko. Woll's stellar play continued in the same period when he thwarted Rourke Chartier's attempt in the slot. As the game progressed into the second period with the score tied at one goal apiece, Woll once again stood tall thwarting Tarasenko's attempt on the far side, maintaining the deadlock. Despite leaving the game with just under ten minutes to play due to injury, Woll was key to the Toronto victory, making a total of 29 saves. His outstanding efforts did not go unnoticed, as he was rightfully named the game’s “First Star,” solidifying his impact on the ice in the Battle of Ontario clash.

description:
In the Dallas Stars' 2-0 triumph over the Winnipeg Jets, Jake Oettinger showcased a commanding presence in the net. Throughout the game, he successfully thwarted numerous high-quality scoring chances, preserving his shutout bid. In the second period, during a two-man advantage for the Jets, Oettinger swiftly gloved Josh Morrissey's shot from just inside the faceoff dot. Early in the third period, with Winnipeg maintaining pressure, Oettinger once again came up big by stopping Morrissey in the slot, preventing another prime scoring opportunity. Oettinger's remarkable 27-save performance earned him the well-deserved first star of the game honors.

description:
On a night when the Lightning faced a substantial shot deficit of 45-18, Andrei Vasilevskiy stood tall, delivering a game-saving performance with a 3-0 shutout against the Red Wings in Detroit. Late in the first period, while preserving a 1-0 lead, Vasilevskiy made his first significant save of the night by denying Tyler Bertuzzi's doorstep attempt with a remarkable left pad save. In the second period, he once again demonstrated his prowess by stopping Jake Walman's wrist shot and following it up with a right pad save. Then, in the same period, he thwarted Dylan Larkin's scoring attempt with another well-executed pad save, maintaining Tampa Bay’s 1-0 lead at the time. The 3-0 victory marked one of the four shutouts Vasilevskiy achieved during the 2022-23 season.

description:
In what some are speculating could be his final NHL season, Marc-Andre Fleury had the opportunity to play in front of a large gathering of friends and family in Montreal, a city near his hometown of Sorel, Que. This trip to Montreal marked the only visit the Minnesota Wild would make in 2023-24. In truly spectacular fashion, Fleury delivered a remarkable performance for the crowd, making several incredible saves on his way to a 5-2 victory. In the first period, after a Wild turnover, Fleury shut down Josh Anderson's attempt right in front of the crease. In the final five seconds of the second period, Fleury showcased his skills with two incredible saves. The first was denying Brendan Gallagher's shot in the slot, and then he followed it up with a pad save on Tanner Pearson’s rebound attempt. To top it off, in the early moments of the third period, Fleury made an acrobatic save using a two-pad stack to thwart Johnathan Kovacevic's scoring attempt. Following the game, Fleury was greeted with admiration and cheers from the Montreal crowd.

description:
As the 2022-23 season was drawing to a close, the Calgary Flames and Winnipeg Jets found themselves in a fierce battle for the final playoff spot. In a crucial matchup between the two teams, Jacob Markstrom rose to the occasion in what felt like a must-win game, turning aside 34 of 35 shots for Calgary. During the second period, with the Jets holding a 1-0 lead, Markstrom made a pivotal stop on Pierre-Luc Dubois' doorstep attempt just before Calgary stormed down the ice to tie the game. Later in the same period, with the score level, he showcased his skills by blocking a blistering Mark Scheifele slap shot and then diving to thwart Josh Morrissey's rebound effort. In the final two minutes of the game, Markstrom preserved Calgary's two-goal lead by denying Nikolaj Ehlers on a breakaway attempt. Markstrom's exceptional performance rightfully earned him the first star of the game honors in this high-stakes matchup.

description:
Juuse Saros delivered an outstanding performance against Buffalo, thwarting 34 of 35 shots faced. After the Sabres closed in with a penalty-shot goal to cut the Nashville lead to just one, Saros faced a flurry of prime scoring chances in the second half of the game. In a late second-period chance, Saros showcased his resilience with a solid save on Alex Tuch's slot shot. Then, in the waning moments of the second period, Saros made a pivotal stop on Dylan Cozens, preserving the lead for the team entering the third period. Saros continued his stellar play with another crucial left pad save on Cozens in the middle of the third period. Recognizing his exceptional efforts, Saros earned the well-deserved first star of the game honors.

description:
In a game where the Winnipeg Jets were outshot 34-20, they leaned heavily on Connor Hellebuyck. His performance included several crucial saves that played a pivotal role in securing the final playoff spot for the team. Hellebuyck's first significant stop occurred late in the second period when he extended his pad to deny Mats Zuccarello after a cross-ice pass, preserving Winnipeg's two-goal lead. Early in the third, during a Minnesota power play, Hellebuyck made a remarkable save on Kirill Kaprizov's redirection attempt, leaving Kaprizov in disbelief. With the Jets holding a 3-1 lead and just over a couple of minutes remaining in the game, Hellebuyck once again amazed everyone with an incredible stick save. This performance was even more remarkable as Hellebuyck made his 13th consecutive start, demonstrating his indispensable role in the Jets' victory and their ultimate playoff spot.
